name: VZW Klimaatzaak v Belgium

jurisdiction.court: Tribunal de première instance francophone de Bruxelles (French-speaking Court of First Instance of Brussels) (2021); Cour d'appel de Bruxelles (Brussels Court of Appeal) (2023)

description: Action by the association VZW Klimaatzaak, supported by more than 58,000 co-claimants, against the Belgian federal State and the three Regions (Flanders, Wallonia, Brussels) for deficiencies in climate policy. The duty of care under Art. 1382 of the Civil Code (CC) (later Art. 1240 of the new CC) and Arts 2 and 8 ECHR were invoked.
outcome: At first instance (2021) the Court found a breach of the duty of care and of Arts 2 and 8 ECHR by all four administrations, the federal State and the three Regions, collectively and individually, but refused to set binding targets. On appeal (30 November 2023) the Court found no breach by the Walloon Region and ordered the federal government, the Flemish Region and the Brussels Region to reduce greenhouse gas emissions jointly by at least 55% by 2030 compared with 1990. This was the first Belgian injunction with a quantitative target.
